H1_TITLE: Account handover rules - marketing, UA & socials
H1_DESC:
For Fred's accounts before the cuts. These replace the old Company Accounts & Access page on Confluence for marketing.

1. Scope: every marketing, UA, ad-monetization and social account in my Sep 30 sweep folder that has Fred on it in any role. Store accounts (App Store Connect, Play Console) and data tools (Singular, Metabase) are on the engineering card. Networks we only reach as bidders inside MAX are not separate accounts here.
2. Holder = Owner or Admin. Managers, standard users, analysts, content admins, pending invites and anyone logging in with someone else's password don't count.
3. A company holder is a holder on a harmonygames.co login. A personal address isn't outside access, it just isn't a company holder.
4. Class: OUTSIDE ACCESS if an agency, contractor or partner business has admin or partner admin access. Otherwise SINGLE if fewer than two company holders, COMPANY-HELD if two or more.
5. Action: OUTSIDE ACCESS -> REVOKE. Otherwise no money moving -> CLOSE. Otherwise SINGLE -> TRANSFER (Leonard becomes the second owner), COMPANY-HELD -> KEEP.
6. Register columns: account, holders that count, class, money moving (Y/N), action.
7. Socials that need a transfer go as a checklist on Fred's "Lock up social handles and domain?" card on the UA/BD board. Don't open a new card.

If anything changes I'll put it in the comments here.
